page: Amazon Web Services r8id.2xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor operating at 3.9 GHz. This configuration provides 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled. The CPU includes a 480 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. It supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512, Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX_TILE, AMX_INT8), and cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA_NI.

The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, yielding 8.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, it includes a bundled 474 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-threaded capabilities, with Geekbench single-core scoring 2177.0 and single-threaded gzip compression reaching 34.56 GB/sec. Text processing is highly efficient, scoring 2983.0 in Geekbench, which is in the top tier. Multi-core performance is moderate, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 8391.0 and a stress-ng multi-core score of 8648.61. Memory bandwidth is measured at 641.02 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 68.58 GB/sec for uncached large blocks.

This instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads requiring high-speed local scratch space, owing to its DDR5 memory density and integrated NVMe storage. It is well-suited for database operations, Redis deployments (achieving 15.3 million SET operations per second), software compilation, and light LLM inference. However, text generation on larger models is a tradeoff, as the 7B model text generation speed is relatively weak at 8.73 tokens per second.
